items.title: Pilgrim Man Using a Field Hoe
items.alt: A man in a brown doublet and green breeches uses an iron-bladed wooden-handled hoe in a small planted soil bed.
items.description: A man in a brown doublet and green breeches uses an iron-bladed wooden-handled hoe in a small planted soil bed. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.
